name: services/tt/classgroup_dates
description: This is an older version of classgroup_dates method. It takes the same parameters, but it returns dates only. Also, some of the dates with "unsure" frequency are removed from the results.
brief_description: Get dates of all activities related to a class group.

arguments.name: unit_id
arguments.description: ID of class group's "parent" course unit.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A list of strings. Each string is a date in the "YYYY-MM-DD" format.
